name: liquid-gradient

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the full pill with a balanced rainbow and the label clear, with no cursor in view.

tagline: Rainbow ribbons swirl inside a rounded banner behind white text.
summary: Seven overlapping gradient sheets blend into a slow, liquid rainbow that keeps reshaping. In the demo it fills a rounded pill behind the words Get early access and slows down while hovered.
appearance: A wide pill-shaped banner on a black page, filled edge to edge with layered rainbow gradients — hot pink, orange, green, cyan and violet — that curve and fold like fabric. Centred white bold text sits on top.
behaviour: The gradient morphs and reshapes on a continuous ten-second loop, never sitting still. Hovering stretches the same motion over a fifty-second cycle, so the colours drift much more slowly while the label stays fixed.
demo_content: A white label reading Get early access on the gradient pill.
search_phrases: liquid colour flowing inside a pill
use_when: A signup or early-access CTA needs to feel animated and eye-catching without extra illustration.
avoid_when: The motion cannot be paused, and the fixed rainbow palette may fight a restrained brand.
customise: Seventeen colour slots are passed as a colors object, and isHovered toggles the slow cycle. The pill size, label and layout live in the demo rather than the component.
weight_why: Seven layered SVG gradients animate dozens of stops every frame.

a11y.note: The gradient never stops and ignores reduced-motion, and the pill is a plain div without button semantics.

issues: The pill looks like a button but is a plain div with no click action or keyboard focus.
White label loses contrast where the brightest yellow and green bands pass behind it.
polish_why: Rich, smooth flowing colour; the white label dips in contrast over the brightest bands.
